title: The Workflow reconciler records nothing a mechanical intervention count can count
body: EpicReconcilerWorkflow writes no run_event feed lines (appendFeed is only called from run-workflow.ts), no journal or stage records, and its checkpoint keeps only the latest state+reason. Adoption after a restart, holds, and the restart itself are therefore invisible in recorded data, so u9h's clause 'reports its intervention count from recorded data' has no defined mechanical source on the cloud host — the local counterpart (go6/zi2's priorResumes riding the durable checkpoint) was never ported, and k7p's per-tick live stage visibility is equally absent for reconciler-driven runs. The fix is an architecture choice that outlives the epic (run-branch stage records vs R2 feed lines vs checkpoint counters), so it needs a ruling and a tick, not a guess in a gate-run attempt.
